agreement.agreement/title: Dar El Wasl Service Agreement — System v1
agreement.agreement/terms:
DAR EL WASL — SERVICE AGREEMENT (SYSTEM v1)

This Agreement sets the ground rules for how Dar El Wasl delivers services through a tracked, document-based workflow.

2) Documents and scope
• The official Proposal (PDF) defines the agreed scope, deliverables, and payment schedule.
• Any scope change must be confirmed in writing before execution.

3) Delivery model (tracked execution)
• Delivery is managed through tasks, documents, and status updates.

5) Fees, payment plan, and invoicing
• Fees and milestones are defined in the Proposal payment schedule.
• Overdue payments may pause work.
• All payments are recorded through official receipts.

— End of sample terms —
